#%Module1.0

set elpa_ver "2026.02.001"
set gpu_flag "sm70,sm75,sm80,sm86,sm89"

module-whatis "ELPA $elpa_ver (GNU, OpenMP, CUDA-Aware MPI, CUDA $gpu_flag, A100-tuned, AVX2+AVX512) 
optimized for Zen5 build with GCC 13.3.0 & OpenMPI 5.0.10 & NVHPC 26.3 (CUDA12) & OpenBLAS 0.3.32 & ScaLAPACK 2.2.3, by yulintao@westlake.edu.cn"

module load openmpi/5.0.10-nvhpc26.3-gnu-cuda12-auto saiblas/2603-gnu-auto
set elpa_home /opt/devtools/elpa/elpa-${elpa_ver}-2603-gnu/nvidia

setenv      ELPA_ROOT           $elpa_home

prepend-path LD_LIBRARY_PATH    $elpa_home/lib
prepend-path LD_RUN_PATH        $elpa_home/lib
prepend-path LIBRARY_PATH       $elpa_home/lib
prepend-path PKG_CONFIG_PATH    $elpa_home/lib/pkgconfig
prepend-path CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH  $elpa_home
prepend-path CPATH              $elpa_home/include
prepend-path PATH               $elpa_home/bin

#%Module1.0
# Determin CPU SIMD
set cpu_flags [exec lscpu | grep "avx"]
if {[regexp "avx512_vnni" $cpu_flags]} {
    set avx_flag avx512
    system echo "AVX512 detected, utilizing the corresponding version..."
} elseif {[regexp "avx2" $cpu_flags]} {
    set avx_flag avx2
    system echo "No AVX512, but AVX2 detected, utilizing the corresponding version..."
} else {
    system echo "CAN NOT determin CPU SIMD, please contact the HPC Admin for help, Nya~~"
}

set elpa_ver "2025.06.001"
set gpu_flag "sm70"

module-whatis "ELPA $elpa_ver (GNU, CUDA $gpu_flag) 
optimized for Zen5 build with GCC 13.3.0 & OpenMPI 5.0.8 & NVHPC 25.7 & OpenBLAS 0.3.30 & ScaLAPACK 2.2.2, by yulintao@westlake.edu.cn
CPU SIMD - $avx_flag, GPU $gpu_flag"

module load openmpi/5.0.8-nvhpc25.7-gnu-auto saiblas/2509-gnu-auto
set elpa_home /opt/devtools/elpa/elpa-${elpa_ver}-2509-gnu-${avx_flag}/nvidia-${gpu_flag}

setenv      ELPA_ROOT           $elpa_home

prepend-path LD_LIBRARY_PATH    $elpa_home/lib
prepend-path LD_RUN_PATH        $elpa_home/lib
prepend-path LIBRARY_PATH       $elpa_home/lib
prepend-path PKG_CONFIG_PATH    $elpa_home/lib/pkgconfig
prepend-path CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH  $elpa_home
prepend-path CPATH              $elpa_home/include
prepend-path PATH               $elpa_home/bin
